parameters.query:
-- So the AI knows what the human said when it takes the customer back.
SELECT agent.fn_log_outbound(($1::jsonb->>'customer_ref')::bigint, $1::jsonb->>'text', NULL::uuid) AS logged
 WHERE ($1::jsonb->>'ok')::boolean
   AND COALESCE($1::jsonb->>'customer_ref', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$';

parameters.content:
## 2B — Desk Outbound Sender
The 2B Desk calls this when a human agent replies.

1. Fill **Code: CONFIG** (copy from your two agent workflows).
2. Pick the credentials on the three marked nodes.
3. Activate, then copy the **Production URL** of the webhook into the desk's `N8N_SEND_URL`.

Answers the desk with `{ ok, external_message_id, error }`.
